==Description==
'''Sniper Shrimp Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 19 on the regular track. It had a cost of {{BeachBalls|590}} or {{Robux|54}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|5,460}} or {{Robux|1,172}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|68}} with a total cost of {{Robux|1,475}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a total cost of {{Robux|1,250}}.

==Appearance==
'''Sniper Shrimp Charm''' appearance is based on the {{Color|Surf|Shrimp}} [[Sniper]] skin. The charm has the skin making shrimp fried rice. When used, it will play a sound made when an enemy walks over a {{Color|Surf|Hermit}} [[Trapper]] skin bear trap.

The color changes based on the player's username color, but appears orange in inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*{{Color|Surf|Shrimp}} [[Sniper]] skin making shrimp fried rice is a reference to the "[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/youre-telling-me-a-shrimp-fried-this-rice You're telling me a shrimp fried this rice?]" meme.
